profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer I / Team Lead at Datto, Inc.
profile.jobTitle: Staff Software Engineer I / Team Lead
profile.summary:
My primary experience is embedded system software design using C/C++, PHP, JSON, XML, HTML, Python and Linux shell script . My career focus has been in the field of networking, both wireless and wired. This includes server functionality and user space applications/services (embedded web server/HTTP(S) interface, SSH server/command-line interpreter and SNMP). I have extensive experience with OpenWRT / UBUS development on access points and routers. Most recently, I've been developing microservices in Go/Golang for web-based configuration of remote devices (access points, routers, switches, and managed power units).

Other skills:
GNU programming tools (gcc/g++/make).
Full-stack development.
Yocto/OpenEmbedded build system for cross-compiler (toolchain) bring-up / Linux distribution packaging.
Jenkins build system (continuous integration) administration.
GitLab.
SVN source control administration.
Linux server administration.
Google GCM/FCM.
RESTful API.
SNMP MIBs.
XML validation (.DTD).
Documentation for design, test and product manuals.
Unit test development.
Debugging/troubleshooting.
Defensive coding.

Technical interests:
Security/encryption.
Data encoding/transcoding.
Algorithms.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer I / Team Lead
positions.description:
I am a full-stack Linux developer targeting embedded ARM processors in cloud-managed wireless access points. I produce both a distributable firmware image and contribute to the user-facing cloud-based management application. I develop in C from the kernel to user space levels for the distributable firmware image. I develop in Go/JavaScript/PHP/React/C++/SQL for the cloud-based management application and supporting back-end services.

As the team lead, I:

Coordinate and lead Scrum ceremonies (daily stand-up, sprint planning, sprint review, and sprint retrospective).
Coordinate our firmware and cloud releases with other teams.
Coordinate between teams for resources and dependencies.
Participate in other teams' meetings to ensure our goals are aligned.
Provide support to my team members.

volunteerExperiences.role: Climb Leader / Basic Climbing Education Program Leader
volunteerExperiences.description: I led alpine style mountain climbs and trail hikes for groups up to 12 people. I completed a three year certification process in 2010 to become a climb leader. I maintained various certifications to retain my active climb leader status. I assisted with BCEP (Basic Climbing Education Program) from 2007 – 2010. I Ied my own BCEP group from 2010-2016. I assisted with ICS (Intermediate Climb School) from 2008 – 2015.
